title: Readout from Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent's Meeting with Saudi Arabian Minister of Finance Mohammed Al-Jadaan
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Saudi Finance Minister Mohammed Al-Jadaan on April 14, 2026 to discuss bilateral economic cooperation. The officials signed a Tax Information Exchange Agreement and acknowledged ongoing collaboration. The Secretary thanked Saudi Arabia for its 'cooperation and resilience since the start of the Iranian conflict.'
key_points: Secretary Bessent and Minister al-Jadaan signed a Tax Information Exchange Agreement
Both sides highlighted progress on several bilateral economic initiatives
Bessent thanked Saudi Arabia for its cooperation and resilience since the start of the Iranian conflict
Meeting took place April 14, 2026 in Washington
